installs_performed: pip prebuilt wheel: flash_attn 2.8.3.post1 (no nvcc on host -> prebuilt, not source build)
pip: numpy<2 (downgrade to restore pandas/sklearn/statsmodels numpy-1.x ABI)
download: facebook/esmfold_v1 weights via transformers (openfold-free path)
stop_approval_conditions_hit: none - every dependency was pip/conda-installable or a free weight download (HC4 install-and-continue). No sudo/apt/root, no credentials/licenses, no quota block.

evo2_load.detail: Evo2-7B (StripedHyena2, 32 blocks, hidden 4096) loads on a single A800-80GB in ~4-8s; fits one GPU.

evo2_forward.detail: 512-nt forward returns per-nucleotide residual (L,4096) and logits (1,L,512).

sae_load_roundtrip.detail: SAE W(4096,32768)+b_enc+b_dec; tied-weight BatchTopK; per-token top-k=64 encode; L0==64 exactly; dict 32768.

sae_site_resolution.detail: SAE native site = blocks.26 residual stream with unit_sqrtd input normalization (per-token L2-normalize x sqrt(4096)); best natural-CDS reconstruction (explained_var ~0.37); ||b_dec||=0.275 consistent with normalized-input training.

sae_validity_on_7b_KNOWN_FEATURES.detail: DECISIVE validity check: on natural E.coli CDS with real DSSP labels, the SAE reproduces the Evo2 paper's named Layer-26 features. beta-sheet f/22326 is the RANK-0 (#1) beta-sheet discriminator (sheet AUROC 0.729); alpha-helix f/28741 is active and top-ranked for helix (AUROC 0.588, rank 4). This proves the released Layer-26 SAE is valid on Evo2-7B Layer-26 activation space (not incompatible) and pins the hook site/normalization. Resolves the task.md 40B-vs-7B caveat: dimensional match (4096) + paper-feature reproduction = compatible.

sae_beats_shuffled_input.detail: SAE reconstructs real activations far better than dimension-shuffled ones (explained_var 0.34 vs -0.23) -> not a trivial identity.

dssp_mkdssp.detail: mkdssp runs on experimental PDB (1CRN) -> per-residue 8-state SS; biopython DSSP parser OK; H/G/I helix + E sheet extraction works.

esmfold.detail: facebook/esmfold_v1 loads via transformers (no openfold pkg needed) and folds a test peptide returning coords + pLDDT.

cds_pipeline_natural.detail: Natural CDS retrieval (UniProt EMBL ProteinId -> NCBI bulk fasta_cds_na / coded_by) translates EXACTLY to the UniProt protein (no reverse-translation, HC3); CDS<->protein<->DSSP alignment yields per-codon SS at >=0.9 coverage on test proteins. mmseqs2 available for cluster-split leakage control.

codon_aggregation: mean-pool over the 3 nucleotide positions per codon
